high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from techcrunch.com, displaying an article about the NATO Innovation Fund. The content is focused on the 23 countries involved in the first sub-fund of the NATO Innovation Fund. The list of countries includes Belgium, Bulgaria, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Spain, Turkey, and the United Kingdom. It also mentions that Sweden will join the group following its full accession to NATO, adding €40 million into the fund.
